title: full ballin' experience
lyrics:
pickleball at Las Escadas
we go bannanas

eeeeeverrrryyyyy night,
not an empty court in sight

friendlyyyyyy faaaacess
runnin' us through our paces

ooooo. oooohhhh for the game.
..of love, not shame.

pickleball at Las Escadas
we go bannanas

etiquite, polightness
is what to expect
smiles and kindness 
is what you get.

ooooo. oooohhhh for the game
of love, not shame.

Home of tournements,
money ball
but thats not all

sippin martinis
pool in bikinis

ballin' day done

time for more fun

pickleball at Las Escadas
we go bannanas

pizza's sizzlin
mouths drizzlin

music's ringing
feet are singing
Salsa, salsa, salsa

pickleball at Las Escadas
we go bannanas

arribbaa!
